description: This file implements a speech-to-text conversion utility supporting multiple providers (OpenAI Whisper, AssemblyAI, LocalAI, Azure Cognitive Services, Groq). It exports a function to convert uploaded audio files to text based on configuration.

classes.name: AssemblyAI
classes.description: Client class for AssemblyAI API interactions.

classes.name: Groq
classes.description: Client class for Groq SDK API interactions.

methods.name: convertSpeechToText
methods.description: Asynchronously converts an uploaded audio file to text using various speech-to-text providers based on configuration.
